purpose: Enter a nullable numeric quantity with locale-aware formatting, optional step actions and native form participation.
behaviorProvider: Installed @base-ui/react NumberField Root, Group, Input, Decrement and Increment; shared Aegis useFieldControl and IconButton.

component: Primitive composition, numeric state and interaction delegation
Visible input ref and raw-number form participation
Field association and optional shared step actions
host: Controlled state acceptance and domain validation
Meaningful accessible naming and locale choices
Submission, persistence, finite configuration and financial precision decisions

requirements.statement: Delegate numeric state to Base UI NumberField. A supplied value selects controlled behavior and preserves null as empty; otherwise defaultValue initializes uncontrolled state. Null defaultValue maps to the primitive empty default rather than zero.

Pass onValueChange and onValueCommitted directly to Base UI without dropping their value or event details. Change details preserve primitive cancellation and reason information; commit callbacks report interaction completion, not persistence.

Pass name, form, min, max, step, required, disabled and readOnly to NumberField.Root. Its associated numeric input owns the submitted raw number. The visible input uses the primitive text-editing behavior and has no duplicate form name. The forwarded ref targets the visible input; hiddenInputRef targets the associated numeric input.

Delegate min/max, step, smallStep, largeStep, snapOnStep, allowOutOfRange and allowWheelScrub to NumberField. Keep its arrow-key stepping and defined Home/End bounds; showSteppers only controls the two rendered increment/decrement actions.
Pass locale and Intl format options through to NumberField so localized display and numeric value remain distinct. The wrapper adds no currency conversion, decimal accounting or precision arithmetic.

Use useFieldControl to resolve the real input id, required, disabled, invalid and description references. Associate a standalone visible label when provided; explicit aria-labelledby takes precedence. Enclosing Field help/error references are merged with an explicit aria-describedby.

Render NumberField.Decrement and NumberField.Increment through actual IconButton components when showSteppers is true. Supply localizable action labels and preserve the primitive button interactions and Tab-sequence policy.

When value is provided, update it to accept requested changes, including null. Supply finite meaningful bounds, valid positive step amounts and valid Intl options. Treat defaultValue as initialization, not a reset command.

Own domain validation, error messages, financial calculations, submission and persistence. invalid and Field.error present host decisions; a committed callback does not certify validity. When allowing out-of-range input, decide how native validity and recovery messages are surfaced.

Supply a standalone label, enclosing Field label or input accessible name. Localize step action names where needed. Do not use placeholder text as the label or override the text-input role to claim unsupported spinbutton semantics.

Keep the owned root and input styles within the input token group; real nested IconButton components retain trigger tokens. Preserve keyboard-visible focus, forced-colors indication and stable size metrics across both themes and modes.

limitations: This is a source-backed requirement record, not a current browser result or release approval.
The wrapper adds no native form-reset listener, application validation, asynchronous validation or persistence.

Intl precision options may round committed values. The component does not provide arbitrary precision accounting or currency conversion; compact notation is unsuitable when edited values must round-trip.

Primitive numeric parsing and keyboard behavior remain dependent on the installed Base UI version. The visible element is a text input with a number-field role description, not an added spinbutton role.
